items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: my mother worked for some people to call, the same people at Harry Wills was working on the top board to Willman. W. G. Willman.

ctx.x: Where did you move when you moved to New Orleans, and how old were you about when you moved down to the city?

See, when my mother carried me down there, my mother worked for some people to call, the same people at Harry Wills was working on the top board to Willman. W. G. Willman. Willman. I was waiting for those people uptown, and they stayed on the premises, me, see, my sister, stayed out with my daddy. See, she went there, she went to New Orleans, I think, around 1992, for the Mardi Gras. She never did go back.
